meta.title: RFQ bid: Quote above the budget tolerance

steps.note: Create the RFQ event needed for the vendor-portal bid test.
Configure the event as an RFQ rather than the default auction.
Apply the RFQ pricing template before adding line items.
Add the single RFQ line item whose budget rule will be tested.
Complete the RFQ pricing sheet so the event can be published.

args.goal: set the RFQ line item's budget to 100 and its budget tolerance to 10%; stop when the screen shows both values saved

steps.note: Configure the scenario's budget and tolerance, which has no dedicated catalog step.
Invite the configured QA vendor to the RFQ.
Make the RFQ available in the vendor portal.
Confirm the event reached a real published project page.
Move to the vendor portal while keeping the buyer session available.
Open this event from the vendor's live event list and enter its RFQ bid sheet.
Enter the quote above the 110 tolerance ceiling.

args.because: Bid price exceeds the budget tolerance limit

steps.note: Submit the over-tolerance quote and require Procol's refusal message.
